name: Gasthof Jägerwirt
beschreibung: The Gasthof Jägerwirt in Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser is a traditional inn in Tirol. It is centrally located in the village, not far from the valley station of the Wilder Kaiser Bergbahn. The house offers a cozy atmosphere with wood-paneled dining rooms. Guests can expect regional specialties in the restaurant. The surrounding area is ideal for hiking in summer and skiing in winter. The rooms are functionally furnished. A garden with a sunbathing lawn is available. The inn serves as a starting point for tours into the Kaisergebirge.
